diagnosis: The security policy update handler uses a @PreAuthorize annotation that checks only for the global authority TENANT_ADMIN without evaluating whether the path variable tenantId matches the caller's own tenant ID. An administrator of one tenant organization can tamper with authentication policies and disable MFA for competing tenant accounts.
